instruction: Candid black and white medium close-up of a couple embracing on an outdoor embankment. On the left, the man with wavy hair and a beard (R1) holds the woman in a black beret and dark coat (R2) close, his eyes closed as his head rests against her. The woman stands on the right with her back to the camera. The man's hand is spread flat on her back, embracing her tightly. The background is a softly blurred riverbank under overcast, diffused daylight, enhancing the quiet, emotional mood.
